world.title: EU leaders aim for agreement on next multiannual EU budget by year-end
world.description: MLex Summary: At the next summit of EU heads of state and government — scheduled to take place in Brussels on June 18 and 19 — they will reiterate their aim to reach an agreement by the end of the year on the next EU budget, according to a draft of the final conclusion obtained by MLex. The multiannual financial framework, which will run from 2028 to 2034, will be key for the bloc's economic recovery. Leaders will also revert to the issue of competitiveness at their summit of October, the draft conclusions say.
